rules.action: Provisional single-stent strategy is the default for all bifurcation lesions including non-complex LM (EBC MAIN). Upfront 2-stent only when DEFINITION complex criteria are met.
Wire both branches before MV stenting. Jailed SB wire technique protects against abrupt SB closure and facilitates re-access. Optional for SB <2mm.
POT mandatory immediately after MV stent deployment. Balloon sized 1:1 to proximal MV reference; positioned just proximal to carina reaching proximal stent edge. Short NC balloon preferred.

Re-wire SB through the proximal stent cell after MV deployment + POT (pullback rewiring technique). Confirm wire position with contrast or imaging — abluminal rewiring carries 23% MACE risk if untreated.
Routine KBI is NOT recommended in provisional strategy. KBI only if: SB TIMI <3, residual SB ostial stenosis >75%, or significant SB ostial dissection (>Type B).
rules.caution: Do not perform routine KBI — reserved for rescue indications only. Use short balloons; MV balloon sized to distal MV.

rules.action: rePOT (final POT) mandatory after any KBI or SB balloon inflation to correct oval MV deformation. Same balloon sizing as initial POT.
Convert provisional to SB stenting only if: TIMI <3 flow in SB, significant ostial stenosis >70% with ischaemic signs, or extensive dissection (>Type B). TAP is the preferred bail-out technique.
SB ostial pre-dilation should be considered before MV stenting when tight, calcified, or angulated SB ostial stenosis with disease length >10mm. Facilitates subsequent re-access and KBI.

Upfront 2-stent indicated per DEFINITION criteria: SB >2.5mm with ostial disease AND SB stenosis ≥70% with lesion length ≥10mm. DK-Crush preferred for most anatomies (DKCRUSH-V); Culotte for equal-calibre vessels with non-acute angle.
FKBI mandatory after all 2-stent techniques. Both balloons simultaneously; align markers at the carina. Failure to perform FKBI is associated with significantly higher MACE.
rules.caution: FKBI failure constitutes technical failure of the 2-stent procedure.

rules.action: Intravascular imaging mandatory for all planned 2-stent bifurcation procedures. 3-run protocol: pre-stent (both branches), after POT/rewiring, and final post-optimisation. OCT reduces MACE by 30% in bifurcation PCI (OCTOBER).

DK-Crush strongly favoured for acute SB angle (<45°). Works well with large MV-SB size mismatch. Re-wire through proximal cell after crushing — inadvertent distal cell entry compromises first kissing balloon.
rules.caution: Culotte is technically challenging with acute-angle bifurcations.

rules.action: Culotte favourable for obtuse SB angle (>70°) with similar-calibre branches (≤1.5mm diameter difference). DK-Crush remains acceptable. DK-Culotte is a bail-out option when provisional converts to 2-stent. FKBI mandatory.
DK-Crush preferred for moderate SB angle (45–70°). TAP (T-and-Protrusion) is an acceptable alternative and the preferred bail-out technique when provisional converts to 2-stent at this angle.
Size MV stent 1:1 to distal MV reference; expand proximally with POT to proximal LM size. IVUS-guided sizing mandatory — angiographic estimation is unreliable for LM dimensions.
